title: Which guidance applies to Offline Access and Camera Upload?

question.author: member_133
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of offline access and camera upload. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Mobile Apps documentation says: Mark any file or folder as "Available offline" to pin a copy on the device; pinned items stay in sync over Wi-Fi by default. Camera upload sends new photos and videos from your device to the Camera Uploads folder automatically, in original quality. Camera uploads count against your storage quota and can be paused per network. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
